items.html:
Like his favourite cricketer, Sachin Tendulkar, Terryn Fray is also a right-hand opening batsman in Bermuda's squad for the Under-19 World Cup in 2008. Fray, whose father also played for Bermuda, top scored for his country in the Americas U-19 qualifier in 2007 and was the tournament's third-highest run-scorer.
Cricinfo staff February 2008
